hoy.titular: All set: the Pincha wrap up training and Montevideo turns red and white

foto.alt: Estudiantes fans fill the stand at the UNO.

hoy.resumen: The squad completed their last session in Montevideo and Fabricio Pérez is lined up to replace Baltasar Rodríguez. The first Pincha fans have already taken over the city, with the bulk of the caravan crossing overnight and on Saturday morning.

siete.titulo: Fabricio Pérez picked to fill Baltasar's place
siete.texto: In the last session in Montevideo, Medina lined up Muslera; Mancuso, Núñez, González Pírez and Rojo; Fabricio Pérez, Piovi, Castro and Tobio Burgos; Tiago Palacios and Carrillo. A back five with Gastón Benedetti remains an option, from the start or during the match.

The first Pincha fans have taken over the rambla, the city centre and Parque Rodó, the area set aside for Estudiantes supporters. The bulk of the caravan crosses overnight and on Saturday morning: around 35,000 are expected in Uruguay.

siete.titulo: Correa available, likely to start on the bench
siete.texto: Joaquín Correa trained alongside his team-mates after the tear he suffered against Flamengo and will be available to Medina as an option. He is expected to start the final among the substitutes.

siete.titulo: A DJ before kick-off, funk at half-time
siete.texto: CONMEBOL confirmed that Uruguayan DJ Diego Maciel will open the ceremony with songs from both clubs, and Brazil's Pedro Sampaio will put on the first half-time show in a final, lasting seven minutes. Mariano Andújar will walk out with the Cup for Estudiantes.
The club president travelled with his family, will join the delegation at the squad's hotel and will watch the final from the stands at the Centenario.

siete.titulo: Piovi: "We will go on the attack"
siete.texto: After the first session in Montevideo, Ezequiel Piovi said the squad have already studied Palmeiras and warned: "On Saturday we will go on the attack, as we have done so far". For him, it is the biggest match of his career.

siete.titulo: Giay: "Estudiantes are a very big club"
siete.texto: Palmeiras' Argentine full-back, who trained in Montevideo alongside Flaco López, praised the Pincha ahead of the final, and Abel Ferreira described them as "a fluid side". Paulinho, injured since October, remains a doubt.
